record.title: NMC532 | Mohtat2020 original author model | Up_0

temperature.description: Not established from the upstream OCP function; no temperature dependence supplied.

x.definition: Electrode lithium fraction c_s/c_s,max in the upstream function; not whole-cell SOC.
x.domain_basis: Author's full-cell balancing endpoints in main.m; source expression retained. Not a claim of independent electrode characterization.

cell_link.evidence: Original author model is bundled with these five experimental charging files in the same DOI deposit. Cell is fabricated by UMBL, not an identified commercial part. Exact specimen identity is not given.

processing.changes: MATLAB continuation and element-wise powers transcribed to the restricted expression language; source coefficients unchanged; no MATLAB executed.

limitations: Original author model is bundled with these five experimental charging files in the same DOI deposit. Cell is fabricated by UMBL, not an identified commercial part. Exact specimen identity is not given.
NMC532 label is stated in the pinned PyBaMM implementation; the deposited model/README use NMC without an independent composition assay.
Original graphite expression uses x+0.007. PyBaMM v25.4.2 uses x+0.001. These are distinct implementation variants; do not mix their OCPs silently.

mohtat-2020-data.title: UofM pouch cell voltage and expansion dataset and modeling code
